user_steering: 只复查API筛选出的caption语义，不再逐题审核原始图像，提高效率。
scope: 825 prior question IDs; recover all caption selections/time windows across archived versions; review nonempty selections only.
selection_rule: Union explicit caption IDs and all captions overlapping API-proposed intervals or archived groups; no 40-caption cap; no new full-video search.
grouping_rule: 事件、动作、对象状态、比较对象、语义阶段优先；连续活动不强制合并，时间相隔较远可分别成组，不设统一秒数门槛。
necessity: 根据caption语义判断是否需联合多组；不再执行图像、删组或反搜验证。
outputs: grouping, requires_multiple, coverage, reference_consistency, cited caption IDs and timestamp envelopes; no source-confirmed promotion
boundary_precision: caption-level timestamps, not frame-accurate event boundaries
